generation.path: Tag lines name the variety (safe conditioning text). Phrases are small sets of attested lexical markers — eastern -इछ perfectives (गइछ/भइछ/खाइछ for standard गएछ/भएछ/खाएछ) and Doteli/far-west past forms (भया for भयो, रह्याको for रहेको, भण्याको for भनेको) — pending linguist review. The calibration pipeline (accent-adaptation.md §6 P0.4) replaces phrases and may add clusters. Structural corruption is refused by DialectLexicon.issues(); wrong-but-well-formed content degrades softly (soft lexical bias inside a <=100-token budget).
